name: Löyly
priceLabel: €29 / 2h · extra hour €12 · towel and shower things included
sauna: A smoke sauna (18 m²) and a wood-heated sauna (22 m²), both single-fired, about 20 bathers each
pool: The sea, from the terrace, all year if the weather allows
hours: Daily, roughly from noon to 22:00; the times change by day, so check their page
flag: The saunas are mixed, so swimwear is required (rental €8). Booking ahead is recommended.

name: Allas Sea Pool
pool: A heated pool and a seawater pool
hours: Mon–Fri 06:30–21:00 · Sat–Sun 08:00–21:00; ticket sales end an hour before closing
bestFor: Swim in the harbour, then a sauna

name: Kotiharjun sauna
priceLabel: €16 · reduced €13 · 10 visits €140 · towel €4 · full wash €15 (Thu & Sat)
sauna: Helsinki's last wood-heated neighbourhood sauna: separate men's and women's public saunas, plus an electric sauna for hire
pool: No pool; you cool off on the pavement out front

name: Uusi Sauna
sauna: Separate men's and women's saunas heated with wood pellets, about 20 bathers each, and an electric mixed sauna
pool: No pool; a terrace for cooling off
bestFor: A public sauna with a bar

name: Kulttuurisauna
sauna: Wood- and pellet-heated, one single-fired mass stove; Friday evenings are silent
pool: The sea, and an ice hole in winter
hours: Mornings Fri–Sun 08:00–11:30, walk in · evenings Wed–Sun 16:00–20:00, booked ahead
bestFor: A quiet sauna on the water
flag: No groups: more than two people count as one and are not admitted. Bring your own towel.

name: Sompasauna
sauna: Run by volunteers with no staff: whoever comes heats it. Mixed, and clothing is up to you
bestFor: A free sauna you heat yourself
flag: No running water, showers or changing rooms. Bring drinking water, a towel and a padlock for the lockers.
aufgussNote: Nobody works there; whoever comes heats the stove and throws the water

name: Sauna Hermanni
sauna: Separate men's (30 bathers) and women's (20) sides, heated with IKI stoves; a public sauna since the 1950s
hours: Mon, Wed–Fri 15:00–20:00 · Sat 14:00–18:00, bathe for an hour after · closed Tue & Sun
